notes: SynthID is embedded in every Omni clip: never try to remove it
check the master with a C2PA reader; re-encoding usually drops the manifest, so the platform toggles are the label of record
paid ads reaching New York need the conspicuous synthetic-performer disclosure; the AI persona is never shown as a real person
never claim or imply that the footage or the voice is human-made

qa_gate.check: Omni clips 24 fps; the master 30 fps
no letterbox or pillarbox bars (ffmpeg cropdetect)
zero scene cuts inside a single-shot clip
no legible text, captions, logos or watermarks (real-label shots excepted)
the same presenter as the reference sheet: face, hair, glasses, outfit
the product matches its photos: shape, colour, size; no invented logo or label text
five fingers per hand, no fusion, plausible contact (checked at final resolution)
no morphing, melting or detaching parts; objects stay the same object
B-roll: no speech (voice-activity detection) and no music
no music in the clip or the master
lip-sync offset inside the ITU window after the lip-sync pass
key action inside x120-888, y288-1248 of 1080x1920
model id, seed, interaction id, cost and verdict logged per attempt

workflow.do: build refs/ from render.json refs[]: presenter sheet first (AI lane, synthetic adult), real product photos, set plate, frame-0 still
python3 .agents/skills/omni-render/scripts/omni_render.py --job jobs/led-sunrise-alarm-lamp --pass draft; then a contact sheet + 360p draft cut as an artifact for human review
per failing shot: <= 3 draft attempts; --edit for local fixes (<= 2 turns), else re-render, then --use-fallback; never drop a beat
python3 .agents/skills/omni-render/scripts/omni_render.py --job jobs/led-sunrise-alarm-lamp --pass final (1080p, same inputs and seed)
lipsync-pass skill on every lipsync.required shot (Cartesia segment by words.json, +45/-125 ms)
python3 .agents/skills/assemble-master/scripts/assemble.py --job jobs/led-sunrise-alarm-lamp -> led-sunrise-alarm-lamp-master.mp4 (24->30 by frame duplication, -14 LUFS / -1 dBTP, no music)
python3 .agents/skills/qa-judge/scripts/qa_probe.py --job jobs/led-sunrise-alarm-lamp --pass final + the Gemini judge on stills
write render_report.json (per shot: attempts, verdicts, cost, files)
